faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Hamirpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Hamirpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant.

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the PDF) and send it to Principal Investigator of the Project Dr. Somesh Kumar Sharma, Associate Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Hamirpur HP - 177005, by post, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of receipt of application). Relaxation: SC/ST/PWD 5 years, OBC non-creamy layer 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma/B.Tech and higher qualification.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have at least 60% marks from a recognized university.

faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates. Interview.

faq.answer: Position is purely on contract basis with initial appointment for a period of one year, extendable up to project duration.
